name: @khorsheed/dsh-canvas
description: 灵感画布：与工作区平级的主题画布空间（左导轨整页卡板：碎片/问题/依据/资料/文档卡、幽灵提议、归档不删除），另含工作区级灵感稿纸右栏 tab

compat.notes: 灵感画布 is a page-type right-Sidebar tab (0.1.5's sidebar.right.pane.tab + sidebarRightTabs registry, the local-files precedent) — hosts before 0.1.5 have no right Sidebar seat, so minHost moved up with it. v2 adds the canvas SPACE: a root-scoped `main` panel keyed 'canvas' plus its `sidebar.panellist` rail row (the ui-layout/ui-sidebar seats, present on every shipped web line); both registrations ride ctx.slots.inject, so a host without those seats degrades to the v1 tab alone. It is a web surface: a headless profile has no browser consumer and the plugin contributes nothing there. The host half writes through the mounted `ctx.fs` with the CALLING SESSION's resolved sandbox policy stamped on every mutation (`ctx.sandboxPolicy` + the wire's agent-first convention, on 0.1.5 the shape dsh-datasets already uses), so the fence hangs on that session's own workspace; a deployment whose policy home is missing degrades to the backend's own fallback rather than failing to load. The v2 board is deployment-level state ($DSH_HOME/state/canvas) that no session workspace can hold: board mutations keep the calling session's resolved MODE and session id but re-root the writable boundary at the plugin's own state dir (a read-only deployment still denies); the state root falls back to process.cwd() when DSH_HOME is unset, the datasets precedent. It registers no model-facing tool and injects nothing into the prompt (the v1 contract is copy-the-path-by-hand; the v2 chat/agent lands in later milestones). Pasted images write through the host's content-addressed attachment store (@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment, an optional peer probed with ctx.get('attachments')): the card text keeps only an attachment:// pointer, the render side resolves that scheme alone (a hand-written local path never becomes a file request), and a deployment without the store degrades an image paste to one notice while text paste stays intact. Free-hand drawing asks nothing of the host: strokes are stored on the card as a point list (the 600×400 logical box) and the outline library (perfect-freehand, MIT, zero dependencies) is bundled into lib/client.js, so no extra install, file or store is involved. 0.4.5 deletes the long-form view, and with it the `canvas/readDraft` and `canvas/writeDraft` Remote verbs: a shrinking of the published remote surface, with no in-tree consumer left behind. 0.4.6 registers a single right-sidebar tab kind again: the `canvasDetail` kind and its `dsh-resource://canvas/<canvasId>/<cardId>` addresses lived for one release and are deleted, because the row of open tabs now belongs to the canvas surface itself and asks nothing of the host dock beyond that one seat. The dock keeps tab layout in memory per session, so no stale `canvasDetail` address survives a restart.
